description:
Why do India's submarines still have to come up and breathe every few days, and what can AIP, air independent propulsion, change?
DRDO's AIP makes hydrogen from a white powder, under water. To fit it, a Kalvari class submarine has to be cut in two at Mazagon Dock.
How AIP works, why it doesn't make a submarine invisible, and why INS Khanderi's trials matter more than any headline.
